# GPT Image 2 Hub

> A curated prompt atlas for GPT-Image-2 (ChatGPT Images 2.0, released 2026-04-21 by OpenAI). 1,400+ real generations across 178 themes, each shipped with its full copy-paste prompt.

GPT Image 2 Hub is a public inspiration library for the GPT-Image-2 model. Every work is paired with the exact prompt that produced it, so readers can remix or learn prompt patterns directly. Content is organized by theme (e.g. fictional symbol systems, multi-script posters, phonics sheets), then grouped into series or single studies.

## What this site offers

- [Home (browse all themes)](https://gpt-image-2-hub-seven.vercel.app/): Masonry grid across 178 themes
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ChaosRealmsAI/gpt-image-2-hub): Source, prompts, meta.json files
- [README](https://github.com/ChaosRealmsAI/gpt-image-2-hub/blob/main/README.md): English gallery index
- [README (简体中文)](https://github.com/ChaosRealmsAI/gpt-image-2-hub/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): Chinese gallery index

## Categories

- [Typography & Text](https://gpt-image-2-hub-seven.vercel.app/#c-typography): Invented scripts, multi-script posters, ambigrams, book restoration
- [Narrative & Sequence](https://gpt-image-2-hub-seven.vercel.app/#c-narrative): Comic pages, storyboards, sequential art
- [Illustration & Style](https://gpt-image-2-hub-seven.vercel.app/#c-illustration): Hand-drawn, flat graphic, 3D render, collage
- [Photography & Realism](https://gpt-image-2-hub-seven.vercel.app/#c-photography): Editorial portraits, product shots, documentary
- [Design & Commerce](https://gpt-image-2-hub-seven.vercel.app/#c-design): Brand kits, poster systems, packaging, app launch pages
- [Technical & Diagrams](https://gpt-image-2-hub-seven.vercel.app/#c-technical): Annotated maps, architectural drawings, scientific diagrams
- [Fantasy & Worldbuilding](https://gpt-image-2-hub-seven.vercel.app/#c-fantasy): Alien ecology, underwater cities, field guides
- [Workflow & UI](https://gpt-image-2-hub-seven.vercel.app/#c-workflow): Dashboards, interaction flows, UI mockups
- [Culture & Heritage](https://gpt-image-2-hub-seven.vercel.app/#c-culture): Historical artifacts, regional motifs, museum pieces
- [Science & Research](https://gpt-image-2-hub-seven.vercel.app/#c-science): Field studies, lab visuals, data storytelling

## Keywords

GPT Image 2, GPT-Image-2, ChatGPT Images 2.0, gpt-image-2, OpenAI image model, AI image generation, text-to-image, prompt engineering, prompt library, prompt atlas, AI art gallery, generative AI, reusable prompts, copy-paste prompts, image generation examples.

## Usage

Every theme page lists its works with their English + Chinese prompts. To reproduce a work, copy the prompt and paste it into ChatGPT Images 2.0 (GPT-5.4 backbone). Themes are versioned by slug — permalinks are stable.

Content licensed under MIT (see LICENSE). Prompts are free to copy, remix, and ship.
